content:
Ethan Park: Hey all — accepted the org invite but hitting 404 on https://github.com/redwood/intro-project and cloning fails: "Permission denied (publickey)". Who owns onboarding invites? :wave:
Maya Li: Welcome Ethan! Quick checks: 1) Did you enable 2FA on GitHub? 2) Did you finish the SSO authorization? 3) Any chance you have multiple GH accounts?
Ethan Park: I enabled 2FA. I accepted invite sent to ethan.p@redwood.com. My GH account username is ethanp and i have a personal account too.
IT-Support-Bot: Automated check: SSO=authorized, 2FA=enabled, primary_email=ethan.p+work@gmail.com (verified), team_assignment=missing.
Sam Liu: That +404 + SSH-auth usually means team mapping didn't run or the invite hit the wrong GitHub account. What does `ssh -T git@github.com` print?
Ethan Park: `ssh -T git@github.com` -> "Hi ethanp! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access." So SSH keys are fine.
Maya Li: Please check Settings -> Emails on GitHub and ensure work email is added and verified, then re-authorize SSO. Also try logging out of browser and accept invite in Incognito if you have multiple sessions.
Ethan Park: Work email was secondary; made primary and re-authorized. Still 404. Clone still permission denied.
Evelyn Tran: I'm an org admin — checking console. Ethan is a member but wasn't assigned to `dev-onboarding` due to a mapping race. Adding now and granting write to intro-project.
Evelyn Tran: Added. Ethan, refresh the repo page and try cloning.
Ethan Park: Repo visible and clone works now, thanks! Small follow-up: tried to push and got "remote: GH001: protected branch". Is main protected?
Sam Liu: Yes, main is protected; open a PR targeting main. Also note CLA Bot will check commit email. If your local commits show personal email, change `git config user.email "ethan.p@redwood.com"` and amend commit.
Ethan Park: CLA Bot flagged one commit. I amended and force-pushed to my feature branch. PR shows checks running.
CLA Bot: CLA: Pending — one commit missing company email. Waiting for update.
Ethan Park: Fixed the email and pushed. CLA passed. All good — thanks everyone! :tada:
